conflicts.description: Andrea Jung's FY2023 row in the 2024 proxy prints fees 132,500, stock awards 275,022, all other 6,909 and total 413,431, but the components add to 414,431 ($1,000 more). Fees are corroborated by the program text ($100,000 retainer + $32,500 People and Compensation Chair retainer, d153) and stock by the 1,852-RSU grant at $148.50 (d154), so the error is in either All Other ($5,909 would reconcile; it includes a $5,000 matching gift, d155) or the total. No later filing restates the row; it is recorded as printed (all_other 6,909, total 413,431).

open_questions: The FY2024 retirement gifts to Al Gore and James Bell are included in their All Other Compensation ($10,016 and $11,038) but the 2025 proxy does not break out the gift amounts separately from equipment-program products (d164).
Why the Board Chair's additional cash retainer fell from $200,000 (FY2018-FY2021) to $175,000 from FY2022 is not explained in the 2023 proxy (d142).

coverage.method: Director Compensation tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019-2026 (DEF 14A 2019-01-08, 2020-01-03, 2021-01-05, 2022-01-06, 2023-01-12, 2024-01-11, 2025-01-10, 2026-01-08), one table per fiscal year FY2018-FY2025: 59 rows (7, 7, 6, 7, 8, 8, 9, 7). Each table has Fees Earned or Paid in Cash, Stock Awards, All Other Compensation and Total columns; the option, non-equity incentive and pension/NQDC columns are recorded as 0, and every row's components sum exactly to its printed total except Andrea Jung's FY2023 row ($1,000 off as printed; see conflicts). Tim Cook, the only employee director, is excluded by the proxies (no board pay). Apple filed no 10-K/A, PRE 14A or DEFR14A in the period; the DEFA14As (notices and supplemental materials, e.g. 0001308179-23-000020) carry no director table. Years are Apple fiscal years (52/53 weeks ending the last Saturday of September, d109); fiscal_year_ends are from the FY2018-FY2025 10-K covers (d201-d208). FY2018 began 2017-10-01.
